fields.demonstrated_algorithms: maximum independent set on unit-disk graphs, quantum phase transitions, Z2/Z3 ordered phases, QAOA-style optimisation; a prethermal first-order dynamical phase transition not inherited from the equilibrium phase diagram, mapped with NERSC (AWS blog, 17 Nov 2026)

items.note: «dynamical phase transition that is not inherited from the system's known equilibrium phase diagram … The NERSC-QuEra collaboration combined experiments on QuEra's Aquila, accessed through Amazon Braket, with theoretical analysis and classical calculations on NERSC's Perlmutter supercomputer.» (source class A; digest intake 2026-11-18)
raised over $100m Series A from sovereign, institutional, deep tech and quantum-specialist investors — «Universal Quantum raises over $100m Series A to scale quantum computing globally»

QUDORA Japan K.K. selected for a Japanese NEDO national R&D project on cryogenic quantum packaging — «QUDORA Japan K.K., the Japanese subsidiary of deep-tech trapped-ion quantum computing hardware developer QUDORA Technologies, today announced its selection for a national research and development project under Japan's New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization (NEDO)»

awarded PhotonDelta National Growth Fund Phase II mission, with seven partners, toward a 100+ qubit photonic computer — «QuiX Quantum and Seven Partners Awarded National Mission to Build the Technology Foundations for a 100+ Qubit Photonic Quantum Computer … The Photonic Quantum Computing Mission, funded under Phase II of the PhotonDelta National Growth Fund programme»

Pasqal QPUs can be requested and scheduled as Slurm resources via QRMI (Slurm 26.11 HRES) — «Slurm 26.11 adds a plugin interface for hierarchical resources (HRES), and together with IBM we have connected it to the Quantum Resource Management Interface (QRMI), so that Slurm manages access to Pasqal QPUs around each job.»
